main_text.p: Et ventilabo eos ventilabro Jerem.15.7. Per Apocopam, וַיִּזֹּר Et dispersit, Exod.32.20. Niph. Infinit. בהזרותיכם Quum dispersi fueritis, Ezech.6.8. Futur. וְיִזְרוּ Et dispersi sunt, Ezech.36.19. Pih. Præt. וזֵרֵם Et dispergeteos, 1.Reg. 14.15. Et aliâ significatione, Cingere; Unde זָרִית Cingu, circump'ecteris, Psal.139.3. Partic. מְזָרֶה יִשְׂרָאֵל Dispergens Israelem, Jer.31.10. Plur. יְמְזָרִים קָרָה Et à dispergentibus frigus, Job.37.9. id est, Ventis aquilonaribus, qui nubes dissellunt, & frigus efficiunt, ut R.Levi explicat. Pyh. Particip. præsens, זָרָה Quæ ventilata fuerit, Jesa.30.v.24. Et cum Schurek loco Cholem, ut quidam volunt, וְהַזּוֹרָה Et qui aspergitur, Jesa.59.5. de quo vide etiam in זוּר. Futur. יְזָרָה spargitur, Job.18.v.15. Hiph. Futur. וְהַזְרֵנִי, Vide in אזר.
זֹר m. Limbus, Corona, à Cingendo, Exod.25.24. Aff. מִתַּחַת לִזֹּרוֹ Infra limbum ejus, Exod.30.4. Kimchi in Michlol refert inter Quiescentia secunda à זור, formæ גר.
זָרָא Disperfio, juxta quosdam: Vide & supra in זור.

זַרְזִיף m. Irrigatio, juxta Aben Esram, Psal.72.6. vel; Stillae; Stillatio, juxta R.Salomonem. Inde apud Talmudicos, זרזיף דמיא Gutta aquarum, מטא זרזיפא דמיא על ראשה Pervenit stilla aquæ super caput ejus. Kimchi Radicem facit זרף, repetitâ primâ rad. cali, ut sæpè.

זָרִיר מָתְנַיִם m. Accinctus, Accinctus lumbis, scil. equus, Prov.30.31. id est, Generosus, Pugnax, Sternax, ad militiam strenuus, à Verbo זרה. quod Chald. ince est Cingere, Accingere. R.Levi, Vertagus Lelaps, id est, Canis venaticus, tener lumbis, hoc est, alacer & habilis ad cursum & venationem. Chaldaeus, אַכְנָא Gallus. Referri potest;

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and vowel points are uncertain at several places in this scan (for example זָרָא, זָרִיר מָתְנַיִם, the Chaldee word for cock, and the forms cited from Exod. 32:20, Ezek. 36:19 and Job 37:9). Words such as זוזיר in the text may be misprints for זָרִיר. Not all Hebrew vowel points can be read with certainty; none have been marked with [?] in the text because the consonants are legible. The page ends mid-entry (זרזיר) and continues on the next page.
